purpose: SP12 E cell: a spike-triggered slow outward conductance (KsAHP, docs/evidence/h01-l2-mechanisms/KsAHP.mod) on the B3 soma at two registered doses, against a Nap-removal comparison arm of the same current size that is not spike-triggered. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-11-h01-e-spike-triggered-outward.md.
executor_note: Runs on the Vast.ai box (NEURON 9.0.2, Python 3.12 venv). The kv3-closing-source library is extended with KsAHP.mod (copied from docs/evidence/h01-l2-mechanisms/) and recompiled with nrnivmodl; the driver records the resulting mechanism_library_sha256 in every run report.
image: braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 (reference image; not used by the local executor; it lacks KsAHP)
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed (h01_l2_sweep_export.SEALED) and is not an input of any stage. Sweep 55 (350 pA) was opened by the usable campaign and is not rerun here.
evaluation: One parameter set at its stage's inputs; one evaluation = serial runs in one process.
dose_registration: h01-e-sahp/dose-registration.json (h01_e_sahp.py register on m0-b3-currents-sweep56 with only its first spike kept; hold -67.06 mV; targets 0.020 and 0.059 nA)

0.title: Stage 0: two KsAHP doses and the Nap-removal comparison arm at sweep 56 (200 pA)
0.prediction: KsAHP arms: count 1-2; late-pulse (1800-2000 ms) and mid-pulse (1300-1500 ms) p50 within 1 mV of the human (-67.06 and -67.47 mV); the trace before B3's first spike unchanged within 0.1 mV and the first spike within 1 ms of 1147.2 ms (the gate is silent before a spike); axon-first. Comparison arm (Nap soma density 0): count 3 or more and a late p50 shift between 0 and -1.5 mV against m0-b3-currents (a 0.012 nA lever at 98 MOhm), i.e. it does not land the human's response.
0.rejection: Neither KsAHP dose holds every band: the family, as a spike-triggered gate with a 1 s tail, does not describe the 200 pA response and stage 1 is not opened. If the comparison arm lands count 1 within 1 mV of the human, the spike-triggered reading is not isolated and the decision records that first.
0.unchanged: All B3 flags (m0-b3-currents.candidate.json), nseg factor 9, CVode 1e-10, recorded command plus bias, stop 2100 ms, record_soma_currents. KsAHP gate parameters at the mod-file defaults (vhalf -20 mV, slope 2 mV, tau_on 1 ms, tau_off 1000 ms).

1.title: Stage 1: the surviving dose at sweeps 50, 53 and 43 (250, 310, 110 pA)
1.prediction: 250 pA: count 5-7 with cycles 4-5 of 250-350 ms. 310 pA: count 9-10 with late cycles within 12.8 ms of 120 ms. 110 pA: every sweep-43 onset row (1019-1120 ms) within 1 mV of the human and within 0.1 mV of g0-b3 (no spike, so the gate stays closed).
1.rejection: The 310 pA count falls below 9, or any sweep-43 row moves by 0.1 mV or more against g0-b3, or the 250 pA count leaves 5-7.
